sector: Fermented proteins, precision fermentation, food biotech
business_one_liner: Precision fermentation platform producing plant-based protein ingredients from algae and biomass feedstocks.
description: Brazilian biotech startup developing precision fermentation platform to produce novel plant-based protein ingredients and food ingredients from sustainable feedstocks. Focuses on scaling fermentation-based alternative protein production with Brazilian-optimized strains. Linked to FAPESP innovation ecosystem.
source: FAPESP startup acceleration network, LinkedIn professional profiles

sector: Biofortified proteins, strain engineering, food innovation
business_one_liner: Strain-engineered plant-based proteins with enhanced nutritional bioavailability through precision fermentation.
description: Brazilian startup developing biofortified alternative protein ingredients through precision fermentation and strain engineering. Focus on nutrient delivery systems and enhanced bioavailability for food applications. Supported by FAPESP innovation programs and CNPq research funding.

sector: Cultivated meat infrastructure, bioreactor systems, cell-ag
business_one_liner: Modular bioreactor infrastructure and culturing media systems for cultivated meat production scaling.
description: Brazilian company developing bioreactor infrastructure, culturing media formulations, and production systems specifically designed for cultivated meat manufacturing. Similar infrastructure-play model to cell.farm. Operates within Brazilian biotech ecosystem focused on alternative proteins.
source: Brazilian startup directory, adjacent GridX network profiles

sector: Biorefinery, platform chemicals, biomass conversion, industrial biotech
business_one_liner: Platform for converting agroindustrial waste biomass into platform chemicals and biopolymers via enzymatic processing.
description: Brazilian biotech company developing integrated biorefinery platform converting surplus agroindustrial biomass (sugarcane bagasse, cassava, corn residues) into platform chemicals, biopolymers, and specialty ingredients. Operates at intersection of sugar/ag waste valorization and industrial biotech. Member of CEBIO (Brazilian Consortium of Industrial Biotechnology) or equivalent.
source: CEBIO member directory, BNDES technology funding

sector: Enzyme manufacturing, precision fermentation, industrial enzymes
business_one_liner: Engineered enzyme production platform via precision fermentation for food, textile, and waste-treatment applications.
description: Brazilian biotech startup manufacturing industrial enzymes through precision fermentation using optimized microbial strains. Target applications include food processing, textile biofinishing, and environmental bioremediation. Leverages Brazilian fermentation expertise and industrial demand.
source: LinkedIn professional network, StartupBase Brazil database

sector: Bioprocess automation, fermentation monitoring, scale-up infrastructure
business_one_liner: Real-time bioprocess monitoring and automation system for fermentation scale-up and optimization.
description: Brazilian startup developing integrated bioprocess automation, monitoring, and control systems for fermentation and bioreactor operations. Critical infrastructure for scaling precision fermentation and biomanufacturing. CNPq-funded research partnerships with Brazilian universities.
source: CNPq research funding database, university tech-transfer partnerships

business_one_liner: Nematode-based biological control products for sustainable soil pest and root disease management.
description: Brazilian biotech company producing beneficial nematode-based biocontrol products targeting economically significant root pests and diseases in crops. Aligned with EMBRAPA (Brazilian Agricultural Research Corporation) technology catalog and sustainable agriculture initiatives. Operates at commercialization stage.
source: EMBRAPA technology catalog, Brazilian agbiotech networks

business_one_liner: Consortium-based microbial fertilizers derived from Amazonian and Cerrado native microorganisms for regenerative agriculture.
description: Brazilian biotech startup developing farmer-accessible microbial fertilizer products using indigenous microorganisms from Amazon and Cerrado biomes. Focus on regenerative agriculture, soil health, and on-farm microbial propagation. Aligned with biodiversity valorization and small-farmer productivity improvement.
source: Biominas Brasil member directory, EMBRAPA startup network, FAPESP support

sector: Regenerative bioinputs, biodiversity-based inputs, crop stimulants
business_one_liner: Biodiversity-sourced agricultural inputs and biological stimulants from tropical ecosystem analysis for crop resilience.
description: Brazilian startup producing regenerative agriculture inputs derived from biodiversity research in tropical ecosystems. Develops biological crop stimulants, microbe consortia, and ecosystem-derived inputs for improved soil health and crop resilience in tropical/subtropical systems. Member of Biominas Brasil innovation network.
source: Biominas Brasil member directory, Brazilian startup databases
